modreloader.jbr_guide.title: How to install JBR 21
modreloader.jbr_guide.body:
Hot-adding a mod that ships access transformers, or changes the layout of an already-loaded class, needs JBR 21.

Usually you do not install it by hand: click "Prepare JBR automatically" on the failure screen. The runtime downloads, verifies and unpacks it, restarts on it once, and enables what is needed for you; no launcher changes and no JVM arguments.

If automatic preparation fails (offline, unsupported platform, ...), fall back to the manual steps:
1) Download JBR 21 (21.0.x, pick the archive for your OS/arch).
2) Unpack it inside the game directory (the folder that has mods/) or next to it; not into mods/.
3) Point this instance's Java, in the launcher, at <JBR>/bin/java.
4) Restart the game fully.

JBR found on this machine: %s

No JBR? Put the jar in mods/ and restart: it loads as a normal mod (no hot-add this time).
modreloader.gui.failure.jbr_late_at_hint: This jar ships access transformers. Restart once on JBR and it can be hot-added: the runtime enables what is needed and rewrites access flags of loaded classes (process-wide, L1-only). Use it only for jars you trust.
modreloader.relaunch.jbr.title: Restart on JBR 21?
modreloader.relaunch.jbr.body:
The world is saved and the game restarts on the JBR 21 found on this machine: %s

This only affects this session; the next launch is decided by the launcher, and Mod Reloader offers the JBR path again when needed.
modreloader.relaunch.failed: Could not restart automatically: %s. Restart the game manually.
modreloader.relaunch.unavailable: Automatic restart unavailable: %s. Restart the game manually.

modreloader.preflight.already_loaded: Already loaded; updating requires a restart
modreloader.preflight.guifei: Guifei-tier registry content: requires restart/soft restart
modreloader.preflight.guifei_loadable: Guifei-tier registry content: EXPERIMENTAL hot-add (add-only). The save will require this mod afterwards and cannot be rolled back.
modreloader.preflight.mixin_no_jbr: Fei-tier: this JVM has no JBR enhanced redefinition. Layout-preserving mixins still hot-add; targets that add fields/interfaces are refused.
modreloader.preflight.suggestion.invalid: Make sure this is a complete NeoForge 1.21.1 mod.
modreloader.preflight.suggestion.restart: Restart before replacing the jar; unload/update is not supported.
modreloader.preflight.suggestion.guifei: Registry content needs a guifei-tier soft restart/restart; A1.2 only supports pin/fei.
modreloader.preflight.suggestion.jbr: Use JBR 21 (one click; the runtime prepares it automatically).
modreloader.preflight.suggestion.missing: Install the missing dependency and retry, or restart.
modreloader.failure.title: Load failed: %s
modreloader.failure.library.summary: This is a library (FMLModType: GAMELIBRARY), not a mod.
modreloader.failure.library.suggestion: Hot-add needs a mod container: put the jar in mods/ and restart, or let the mod that needs it bundle it (JiJ).
modreloader.failure.not_a_mod.summary: This file is not a NeoForge mod (no mods.toml).
modreloader.failure.not_a_mod.suggestion: Make sure it is a NeoForge 1.21.1 mod, not Fabric/Forge or a broken file.
modreloader.failure.invalid_metadata.sug: Re-download the mod; verify mods.toml and the jar.
modreloader.failure.already_loaded.summa: This mod id is already in the running ModList.
modreloader.failure.already_loaded.sugge: A1.2 has no unload/update path yet; restart before replacing the jar.
modreloader.failure.missing_dependency.s: Add the dependency to mods and restart, or load it first.
modreloader.failure.jbr_required.summary: Fei-tier layout changes require JBR enhanced redefinition.
modreloader.failure.jbr_required.suggest: Use JBR 21, or wait for sidecar.
modreloader.failure.capability.summary: This runtime cannot hot-add: an internal framework anchor it needs is missing.
modreloader.failure.capability.suggestio: Check the capabilities line in latest.log; this game version probably does not match this build. Nothing was changed.
modreloader.failure.mixin_runtime.summar: This mod declares mixins, which need MixinRuntime (modId: mr); it is not installed.
modreloader.failure.mixin_runtime.sugges: Install MixinRuntime (modId: mr, version >= 1.0.2) into mods/ and restart, then retry.
modreloader.failure.unsupported_tier.sum: This mod needs a restart/soft restart; A1.2 does not hot-add it.
modreloader.failure.unsupported_tier.sug: Put it in mods and restart; registry content needs a guifei-tier soft restart.
modreloader.failure.mixin_config.suggest: Check the mixin config, target and mod version; restart and attach the log.
modreloader.failure.mixin_target.summary: Target class/layout could not be redefined by JBR.
modreloader.failure.mixin_target.suggest: Restart; if it still fails, the mod may be beyond current fei-tier support.
modreloader.failure.redefine.summary: Target class/layout could not be redefined by JBR.
modreloader.failure.redefine.suggestion: Restart; if it still fails, the mod may be beyond current fei-tier support.
modreloader.failure.module.summary: The mod module could not be injected into the game layer.
modreloader.failure.module.suggestion: Check for a duplicate module/jar; retry after a restart.
modreloader.failure.modlist.suggestion: Check dependencies and duplicate mods; retry after a restart.
modreloader.failure.registry.summary: Registry content could not be registered. Registry entries cannot be rolled back.
modreloader.failure.registry.suggestion: Restart the game. If entries were already added, the runtime is dirty and a restart is the only clean state.
modreloader.failure.construct.summary: The mod constructor or lifecycle event threw.
modreloader.failure.construct.suggestion: Check the stack trace; listeners may remain after construction, prefer restart.
modreloader.failure.event.suggestion: Check the stack trace; event listeners may remain, prefer restart.
modreloader.failure.resource_pack.sugges: The mod may be loaded without resources; restart to load the pack normally.
modreloader.failure.datapack.summary: The mod's data pack (recipes, loot tables, tags) could not be applied.
modreloader.failure.datapack.suggestion: The registry content is already committed and cannot be rolled back. Restart with the jar in mods/ so the game loads its data normally.
modreloader.failure.access_transformer.s: This mod ships access transformers (META-INF/accesstransformer.cfg), which only apply at startup.
Restart once on JBR and it can be hot-added (the runtime prepares it); if JBR is unavailable, put the jar in mods/ and restart (no hot-add this time).
This mod registers a startup-only mod-bus event that this runtime does not replay yet; using that content would crash.
Restart the game with the jar in mods/. Hot-add cannot replay that startup registration yet.
modreloader.failure.jar_in_jar.summary: The libraries this mod bundles in META-INF/jarjar could not be made available.
modreloader.failure.jar_in_jar.suggestio: The nested jar is missing, obfuscated or unreadable. Restart with the jar in mods/ so the game extracts it normally.
modreloader.failure.coremod.summary: The mod declares a coremod (ICoreMod), but its bytecode transformers could not be applied safely.
modreloader.failure.coremod.suggestion: Restart the game with the jar in mods/ so the coremod runs before classes are loaded; if it still fails, it changes the layout of an already-loaded class.
modreloader.preflight.access_transformer: This mod ships access transformers (they only apply at startup): hot-add cannot use them. Use "Restart on JBR" once (the runtime enables what is needed), or put the jar in mods/ and restart.
This mod ships access transformers. This session runs on JBR but the needed capability is not enabled yet. Use "Restart on JBR" once, or put the jar in mods/ and restart.
The needed capability is on: access flags of loaded classes are rewritten (process-wide, L1-only)
modreloader.notice.toast.title: Server mod list changed
modreloader.notice.present: Server added %s %s. Your client already has it.
modreloader.notice.missing: The server is hot-adding %s %s (jar %s, sha256 %s...). You do not have it: you will be disconnected shortly and cannot rejoin until the same jar is in your mods/ (then restart). Hot-adding it on your own client works too.
modreloader.sync.applied: Registry mapping from the server applied.
modreloader.sync.missing: The server has content this client does not know; the registry mapping was left unchanged. Install that mod on the client and hot-add it there too.
modreloader.sync.mismatched: Both sides must hot-add the same mods: the server and this client hold different registry entries, so the id mapping was left unchanged.
modreloader.sync.failed: Applying the server registry mapping failed; the previous mapping was restored.
modreloader.failure.rollback_partial.sum: Load failed and rollback was not fully successful.
modreloader.failure.unknown.summary: Load failed; the cause could not be classified.
modreloader.failure.unknown.suggestion: Copy details and check latest.log; report it if needed.

modreloader.preflight.library: This is a library (FMLModType: GAMELIBRARY), not a mod: hot-add needs a mod container. Put it in mods/ and restart, or let the mod that needs it bundle it (JiJ).

modreloader.failure.missing_file.summary: The jar no longer exists at that path.
modreloader.failure.missing_file.suggest: It was moved or deleted after it was detected; rescan the folder.
modreloader.gui.empty_hint: Drop a jar into mods/ or modreloader/inbox, then reopen this list.
modreloader.failure.network_payload.summ: This mod registers custom network payloads, which NeoForge forbids after startup.
modreloader.failure.network_payload.sugg: Install it before launching; a hot-added mod can load but cannot exchange custom packets.
modreloader.jbr_setup.title: Prepare JBR 21 automatically
modreloader.jbr_setup.body: This mod needs JBR 21. One click downloads it from JetBrains (about 95–200 MB, by platform), verifies SHA-512, unpacks it next to the game and restarts on it; what is needed is enabled automatically (this session only).
modreloader.jbr_setup.failed: Failed: %s (the game keeps running; retry, or put the jar in mods/ and restart)
modreloader.failure.custom_registry.summ: This mod creates its own registry during construction, which NeoForge only allows before startup finishes.
modreloader.failure.custom_registry.sugg: Restart the game with the jar in mods/. Hot-add cannot create registries after startup yet; nothing was committed if the window could not be opened.
